tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma la gsungs pa'i thar lam gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sidhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji bzhin gzigs pa'i gzigs pa rnam dag chos kun ngo bo med gzigs cing / /ji snyed mkhyen pa'i mkhyen pa rab yangs dngos kun rmi lam sgyu mar mkhyen/ /tshad med 'gro ba'i 'gro ba 'dren mdzad 'gro mgon chos rje rin po che/ /sa gsum bla ma'i bla ma mchog gi bla med zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i gsung rab gsung gi bdud rtsi'i gdams pa rnams/ /'gro ba'i dug gsum dug lta'i nad kun zhi byed cing / /'chi med mchog gi mchog rab gnas su 'khrid byed pa/ /mkha' 'gro'i snyan brgyud snyan nas brgyud bzhin bri bar bya/ /'dir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen pos/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma la gsungs pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams pa 'di la chos drug ste/ thabs lam bde drod rang 'bar/ sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol/ rmi lam nying 'khrul rang dag 'od gsal gti mug rang sangs/ 'pho ba ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ bar do rgyal ba longs sku'o/ /dang po thabs lam la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /sngon 'gro la gsum gyi/ drug kar gyi sngon 'gror kyang 'gro gsungs/ dang po dag byed a'i stong ra ni/ sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor/ paṃ las pad ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom/ de la 'og nas 'byung ba'i tshul ltar gzhan yang bstims nas/ bla ma rin po che bdag gi nad gdon zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol/ ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag du btab nas rang rang gi smin mtshams su chos 'byung gru gsum rnam thar sgo gsum/ yang rgyan dkar po lta bu/

rtsa ba phra ba thur la zug pas mgrin par slebs pa/ gdengs ka gyen du phyogs pa'i zur cig smin phrag dang / zur gnyis rna ba gnyis su slebs pa/ phyi nang thams cad dkar sing nge ba gcig bsgom/ de'i nang du sems skye med mtshon pa'i a dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can du bsams nas/ ngag tu a a zhes ci rigs pa brjod pas/ a las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun dkar nar babs/ chos 'byung khengs nas lus kyi phyi nang thams cad na mar song bas/ nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bshang lam/ chu so/ sor mo/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad na mar bye ma'i ri la phu chu drag pos btab pa bzhin/ nag bun nu nu phyir sangs sangs 'thon par bsam/ mdor na lus phyi gsal nang gsal phru ma bus pa lta bu'am/ shel sgong dri ma med pa ltar bsam la/ ma yengs par mnyam par bzhag go /de ltar yang yang bskyar zhing bsgoms par byas te/ de sdig sgrib dkor sku klud/ 'gal 'khrul dam tshig nyams chags la sogs pa thams cad 'dag gsung / gnyis pa stong ra nad gdon sel byed ni nad tshad pa shas che na bdud rtsi kha dog dkar la reg bya shin tu bsil bar bsam ga pur gyi rgyun lta bu grang ba shas che na bdud rtsi kha dog dmar la reg bya shin tu me lta bu tsha bar bsam/ rlung nad la bdud rtsi zhun mar la sogs pa bcud can gyi rnam par bsgom/ gdon gnod pa la 'bu srin la sogs pa srog chags kyi rigs mang po chu bo chen po tsam 'thon par bsam mo/ /de ltar 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug thams cad du sdig sgrib nad gdon gsum char la rtse gcig tu gnas pa ni stong ra'i dmigs pa'o/ /gsum pa rtags gsum stong ra'i khyad par ni/ sdig pa dag rtags nam mkha' la 'phur ba dang / nyi bzhur zla bzhur shar ba dang / khang steng dang / gangs rtser phyin pa dang / chu'i steng nas mi 'bying bar 'gro ba dang / ngo tsha'i rtog pa med par gcer pur 'gro ba dang / khrus byas pa dang gos dkar po dri ma med pa gon pa la sogs pa ni/

sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags so/ /'khrus nad skyug dang rnag khrag 'dzag pa dang / lus la rngul mang po 'thon pa la sogs pa ni nad 'thon pa'i rtags so/ /gdon sdom sdig dang / sbal lcong la sogs pa srog chags kyi rigs gang thon yang gdon 'thon pa'i rtags te/ de rnams dngos sam rmi lam ci rigs su 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la lnga las/ dang po lus gnad me'i stong ra ni/ rkang pa dkyil krung sgal tshigs drang po/ mgrin pa cung zad dgug lag pa gnyis sa gnon bya/ ngal gso ba'i skabs su rkang pa bsnol nas tsog pu la lag pa gnyis pus 'khyud byas kyang 'gal ba med gsung / de nas sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ka bsnams pa rus pa dang mi mgos brgyan par bsams pa'i spyi bor/ bla ma sngar bzhin bsgoms la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la bde drod kyi ting nge 'dzin brgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin brgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ de nas rlung ro phyir bus la khams 'dus la sogs gegs mi 'byung la/ rang gi lus phyi rje btsun ma'i rnam pa la nang me mar mur gyi 'obs lta bu/ kha dog dmar la reg bya shin tu tsha ba/ rdza ma bsregs pa lta bu stong sang nge ba'i khog pa'i nang lte ba'i thad kyi phyogs bzhi na/ me ngang pa'i sgong nga tsam bzhi 'bar la khad pa la rtse gcig tu sems gtad la steng 'og gi rlung bzung ngo / /gnyis pa gtum mo zas su za ba ni/ sngon 'gro gong bzhin byas la/ rkang lag bsnol la tsog pur byas pa'i/ rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis lag pas bzung sgal tshigs bsrang mgrin pa cung zad bkug la/ rlung ro phyir bsal/ de nas rang rje btsun mar bsgoms pa'i rtsa gsum gsal gdab/ gsang gnas su yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu'i steng du/

rtsa gsum 'doms sar raṃ dmar po gla ril tsam gcig bsams la rlung gnyis kha sbyar bas yaṃ las rlung g.yos/ raṃ las me kha dog dmar la reg bya shin tu tsha ba/ 'gar so mal lta me stag 'phro bzhin pa dbyibs nas sam/ gzungs mo byi thur mgo mjug phra ba'i rtse mos mgrin par slebs pa/ dbu ma yangs par bsams pa'i nang na yar 'ur sgra dang bcas par 'bar nas/ khog pa khengs par bsam la/ lus kyi las su dkrug 'khor bya/ ngag gi las su rlung bzung mi thub tsa na sha khrag na mar dal bus btang bas drod myur/ sems kyis las su me 'bar bzhin pa'i raṃ dang me'i mtshams su sems rtse gcig tu gtad do/ /gsum pa gos su gon pa ni/ bde ba'i mal du lus brang sbyar la nyal/ lkog ma pus mo la dgal/ lag pa bsnol la lag 'thil bzhi drod pa na 'thil gnyis mchan 'og tu dgal/ me'i dmigs pa sngar bzhin byas la steng 'og gi rlung gzung ngo / /bzhi pa stan du gding ba ni/ rkang pa rten sa la gtad gang rung gcig gi sgyu mo drod khung gi gcig shos kyi bol gong drod mnan/ gzhogs gang rung 'og tu bcug la khyi nyal sgor mor nyal rlung dang dmigs pa gong bzhin no/ /lnga pa srid pa'i dbang zhu ba ni spyi bor bla ma sngar bzhin bsgoms nas/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus/ bla ma'i thugs khar stims la/ lus longs spyod thams cad mchod par phul nas bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa byung nas spyi bo mgrin pa snying kha lte ba nas rkang mthil yan chad gang bas/ rim pa ltar/ dbang bzhi thob pas lus ngag yid/ de gsum tha dad du 'dzin pa'i dri ma bzhi bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas sku bzhi mngon du byas par bsam mo/

/des sdig sgrib dam tshig nyams chags thams cad dag nas gegs mi 'byung / ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa skye/ skyes pa gong nas gong du 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa rjes la gnyis las/ dang po gags rang grol ni/ thabs lam sgom pa'i tshe/ snying mi dga' ba dang shes pa 'phyo ba dang / ro stod mdun rgyab du gzer ba la sogs pa/ stod gegs byung na gang na sar rin po che 'bar ba lta bu'i bu ga dang / lus thams cad na ba la bu ga khrol tshags kyi dmigs lta bu bsgoms pa'i nang nas/ nad gdon thams cad dud pa 'phyur ba ltar sngo dmar sna tshogs bun bun 'thon par bsams la rlung drag du 'bud pa'am/ has drag po gdab par bya'o/ dang lag pa yug pa dang dus la/ smad kyi kunda'i gags ni/ 'khrul dbab bzung bzlog bgram pa'o 'khor dang dmigs pas gsal gsung ngo / /gnyis pa rlung rtar zhon pa'i man ngag ni/ 'gro ba'i tshe lag pa gnyis khu tshur bcangs la/ mchan 'og gnyis su bzhag de gnyis su rlung yang na rkang 'og gnyis su gi lha mo sngon mo gshog pa can re bsgoms la/ de gnyis kyis nam mkha' la khyer bar bsams la/ khug pa nyer gcig rlung bzung nas phyin pas rta mchog dang mnyam pa'i 'gros 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa nad pa stan la bzhugs pa/ gnyis pa sgyu lus la gsum las/ dang po dbang po rab bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pa ni/ de la ci'i phyir grogs zhe na/ 'du 'bral med pas na grogs/ gong nas gong du 'khrid pas na/ yon tan thams cad skyed par byed pas sam/ tshe gcig gam lo zla tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par byed pas na grogs yin gsung / 'di la gnyis kyi/ dang po gsol 'debs bla ma'i lam khyer ni/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i don du theg pa chen po'i chos sgrub snyam du byang chub tu sems bskyed/ de nas 'khor ba la skyo shas drag po bskyed de rdo rje tshig rkang las/

mi rtag skyo shas nyes dmigs sngon 'gro bas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de la sngar skyes pa thams cad shi da gdod skye ba thams cad kyang 'chi/ da lta sa thog na yod pa thams cad kyang shi tshe thar du sdod pa gcig kyang med/ 'chi ba yin cis kyang ci byed shi nas med par yang mi 'gyur te/ rigs drug gang du skyes kyang skyid med ang snyam du bsam la/ de nas rang 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa 'dzin pa dang gnyis su med pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang mi mgos brgyan par bsgoms la de'i spyi bor pad nyi'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi rang bzhin can/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ mtshan thos pa tsam gyis sangs rgyas kyi sa thob na/ gsol ba btab na byin brlabs 'byung ba smos mi dgos pa gcig tu bsam/ de'i thugs kha nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ yi dam lha tshogs/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong / gzhan yang rang gi chos 'brel yod tshad spyan drangs la bla ma la bstims nas/ mdun du rang gi gnod byed kyis gdon nam gzhi dag gis gtso byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad lus gus pas ma mkha' mnyam pa'i thal mo sbyar/ ngag gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ yid gus pas mos gus rgyun chad med par byed par bsams la/ rang gis gsol ba btab pa dang / sems can thams cad khu di ri ri gsol ba 'debs par bsam la/ bla ma rin po che sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag 'dzin blos thongs par mdzad du gsol/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar mdzad du gsol/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs parྎ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs par mdzad da lta myur ba 'dug sa 'di nyid du du gsol/

ces mos gus rgyun chad med par rtse gcig tu gsol ba drag tu gdob/ ye shes mngon 'byung las/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams/ /bla ma'i mos gus lo zlas bgrod/ /bla ma'i snang ba ma bral na/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang 'bral med gnas/ /zhes dang ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i zhal nas/ lam lnga sa bcu'i rim pa rnams/ /mos gus stobs kyis bgrod par byed/ /bla ma'i snang ba mi 'bral ba/ /rgyud sde'i dgongs pa gnad kyi mchog /ces gsungs/ slob dpon birwa pa'i zhal nas kyang lam zab bla ma zhes gsungs pas/ dbang po rab lam gzhan la ltos mi dgos par bla ma'i mos gus nyid kyis grol bar gsungs so/ /gzhan yang lha sku bskal pa stong du bsgoms pa bas bla ma dran pa bsod nams che zhing / sangs rgyas stong gi yon tan 'dzin par 'gyur ba la sogs pa/ mdo rgyud man ngag thams cad nas phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs pas/ lung gis brgyan cing yid ches par bya'o/ /gnyis pa cir snang bden med lam khyer ni/ gong ltar gsol ba btab pas/ snang ba bden med du phyal song ba dang / snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos/ bdag gzhan snod bcud sna tshogs su snang ba 'di thams cad/ rang gi blos bkod/ blos byas pa'i bag chags kyi sems nyid phyi rol gyi rnam par shar ba yin gyi/ sems las tha dad du phyi rol na don logs su grub pa bden pa gcig kyang mi 'dug pas/ sems nyid sna tshogs su snang gin 'dug kyang nges par bden med cig yin ang snyam du bsgom/ gshis bden med yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pas 'khor bar 'khyams par 'dug snyam du bsam/ de ltar rtse gcig tu bsgom pa de mnyam bzhag go /rjes spyod lam rnam bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyi dus su'ang / 'chi ba mi rtag pa dran pa dang / bla ma'i mos gus dung dung pa dang / cir snang thams cad la nges par bden med yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po dang gsum ma g.yengs par rtse gcig tu 'gro 'chag nyal 'dug nyams su blangs pas/

gsol 'debs yan gong bzhin byas nas gnyid log pas gnyid du song ba'i tshe/ g.yang chen po la shor ba'am/ ma'i khyis ded pa la sogs pa'i rmi lam mi 'tshams pa gcig rmis te rmi lam du shes/ rmi lam bden med sgyu mar shes/ sgyu ma sgyu 'dzin thams cad dang bral nas/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur pa de la/ dbang po rab bla ma dam pa grogs su bsten pas lam lnga sa bcu bgrod par bya ba yin gsung ngo / /des lam ma bgrod na/ bla ma la chos sku'i 'du shes ma skyes/ mos gus kyi rtsol ba zhan pa'i stobs kyis/ dbang po 'bring du song ba yin no/ /de la gnyis pa/ dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par 'khrid pa ni/ ci'i phyir de skad ces bya zhe na/ tha mal gyi long gtam lta ci smos/ mdo 'don sngags bzlos pa la sogs thams cad kyang re zhig bzhag la/ yid la yang cir snang thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam/ ngag tu yang sgyu ma rmi lam zhes rtag tu brjod par bya ste/ khyi'u rab snang gis zhus pa'i mdo las/ chos rnams sgyu ma rmi lam zhes/ /gang gis tshig brjod dran gyur pa/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol nas/ /tshe 'di nyid du sangs rgyas nges/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'di nyams su len pa la gnyis las/ dang po rang lus snang stong lha sku ni/ mi rtag 'khor ba'i skyo shas drag po dang / sems skyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar bzhin byas la/ gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ snang ba bden med du phyam song ba dang / rang 'khor lo bde mchog snang ba gzugs su grub pa la reg pa gzugs su ma grub pa/ chu zla'am me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar rang bzhin med par bsgom pa'i sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs rnam pa bzhugs tshul la sogs pa 'di rnams/ rang gi blos bkod nas byas pa ma gtogs pa/ sems las don logs su grub pa gcig kyang mi 'dug sems nyid kyang 'di lta bur snang ni snang /

bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma yin rmi lam yin snyam du rtse gcig tu bsgom/ ngag du yang brjod do/ /gnyis pa cir snang sgyu ma'i lam khyer ni/ rang lus lha sku de ltar yin pa bzhin du/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten khang khyim/ sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal la sogs pa dang / nang bcud kyi sems can skyes pa bud med dgra gnyen/ rta glang po la sogs pa bdag gzhan snod bcud snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos sna tshogs 'di rnams thams cad/ rang gi blos bkod blos byas pa'i sems nyid de ltar du shar ba ma gtogs pa/ sems las tha dad du phyi rol na don logs su bden par grub pa gcig kyang mi 'dug sems nyid sna tshogs snang ni snang bden ni mi bden 'di ka rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam du rtse gcig tu nyams su blang ngo / /de yang snang ba thams cad rang gi sems kyi rang snang yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ rin chen sems las phyir gyur pa'i/ /sangs rgyas med cing sems can med/ /ces pa dang / phal po che las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di dag ni sems tsam mo/ /zhes pa dang / lang kar gshegs pa las/ bag chags kyis ni dkrugs pa'i sems/ /don du snang ba rab tu 'byung / /don yod ma yin sems nyid de/ /phyi rol don mthong log pa yin/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i lung dang / sngon byung gtam rgyud ngo mtshar bas brgyan te nges shes bskyed par bya'o/ /rjes 'gro ba/ 'chag pa/ nyal ba/ 'dug pa/ zas za ba/ gos gon pa/ gtam smra ba la sogs pa spyod lam thams cad du/ nga do nub 'chi'am/ nang par 'chi'am nam 'chi cha med/ cis kyang ci byed snyam pa dang / bla ma'i snang ba dang mi 'bral bar mos gus rgyun chad med pa dang cir snang thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam du sngar bzhin dgyer bar bya/ khyad par du phan gnod dang / gtam snyan mi snyan la sogs pa bde sdug chags sdang gi yul dang phrad pa'i tshe/ 'di ka rmi lam gyi bde sdug la sogs par 'dug snyam du bsam/

mdor na ngag tu yang sgyu ma rmi lam/ sems kyis kyang sgyu ma rmi lam gyi rtsis zin par byas pas ci byas thams cad dge sbyor du 'gro gsung ngo / /ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma ni gu ma'i zhal nas/ cir snang sgom du ma shes na/ /gnyen po bsten gyis ga la lang / /yul ngan yang gis ga la spongs/ /sgyu mar rtogs pas rang sar grol/ /ces gsungs/ ye shes rgya mtsho las/ rang lus sgyu ma'i rnam par rab shes pas/ /'gro kun skyes pa bud med sna tshogs pa/ /thams cad gzugs ni sgyu ma'i rnam pa las/ /mkhas pa su dag de las gzhan du brjod/ /ces gsungs pas/ snang ba thams cad rang gi sems/ sems lha sku bden med sgyu ma lta bu ste/ de ltar mnyam rjes spyod lam thams cad du/ chags sdang gi yul la sogs pa'i cir snang thams cad la gnyen po bsten cing bsgoms pas/ nub mo rmi lam zin/ de bden med sgyu mar shes/ sgyu ma sgyu 'dzin tsam dang yang bral nas 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po ji lta ba bzhin mngon du gyur pa de la/ dbang po 'bring tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par khrid pas lam lnga sa bcu bgrod pa yin gsung ngo / /de ltar nyams su len pa na/ tshe 'di blos ma thongs na ci byas tshe 'di 'ba' zhig gi bya bar 'gro bas/ tshe 'di blos gtong ba'i tshul jo bo chen po rje/ lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po/ kha rag bsgom pa/ zhang rin po che rnal 'byor chos dbang phyug la sogs pa'i lo rgyus dang nyams len gyi skabs su ji ltar mkho ba'i mdo rgyud la sogs pa'i lung sbyor sna tshogs dang / bla ma gong ma'i gsung sgros dang / sngon byung gi gtam rgyud khyad par can rnams ci rigs su gsung ba ni/ 'dir yi ge mangs kyis dogs nas ma bris pas gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /dbang po rab 'bring gnyis la dge sbyor ma skyes na/ bla ma la chos sku'i 'du shes ma skyes pa dang / mos gus dang 'du shes zhan pa'i stobs kyis dbang po tha mar song ba yin no/

/de la gsum pa dbang mi gsum gyi las kyis slad pa de la bya ba dka' shos babs dang lta gsung po tha ma mal gcig tu ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes pa ni/ ci'i phyir de skad ces bya zhe na mal gyi drod ma yal bar nyin mtshan thams cad du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu bsgom dgos pas so/ /de la sad bzhis ma khyer bar bya ste/ 'gro 'dug mang po dge sbyor gyi sad/ 'pho skyes mang po blo sna mang po/ log lta mang po dge sbyor gyi sad yin pas/ de rnams spangs la nyams su blangs gsung / 'di la bzhi'i sngon 'gro gzhan sngar bzhin bsgoms la/ bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab nas/ dang po 'gro drug sgyu mar 'char byed ni/ rkang pa bsnol la tsog pu bya/ lag pa bsnol la pus mo la 'khyud/ rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i lte 'og tu/ chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ dmyal ba tsha grang la sogs pa 'gro drug gi sems can thams cad 'od du ltem ltem bsam la/ de la rtse gcig tu sems gtad pas steng rlung shugs kyis zin/ 'og rlung drag tu bskums la bdag gis gtso byas pa'i 'gro drug gi sems can 'di rnams mi bden pa la bden par bzung bas 'khor ba 'ba' zhig tu 'khyams pa snying re rje snyam du bsam/ 'di rnams thams cad kyang snang ni snang / bden ni mi bden/ sgyu ma rmi lam yin ang snyam pa'i dran 'dun drag po dang / bla ma'i mos gus gnyis rtse gcig tu nyams su blang ngo / /de nas sgyu ma rang shar mi 'byung mi srid do/ /gnyis pa nad gdon sgyu ma'i lam khyer ni/ nad kyi ngo bo bden med sgyu mar bsgom/ yang na nad dang bla ma dbyer med sgyu ma/ gdon gang gnod pa de sna bug g.yas nas lte 'og chos 'byung gi nang du bcug nas chos 'byung kha bsdus la/ dkrug 'khor bya/ gsol ba drag tu gdab/

gdon bden med sgyu mar bsgoms la/ gnod byed des rigs drug gi sdug bsngal nyams su myong zhing dran pas 'gyod pa skyes nas gnod sems zhi nas sna bug g.yon nas mdun du thon pa la lan chags kyi gtor ma byin la mi dmigs par bya'o/ /gsum pa 'char byed yon tan tshogs drug ni/ lte 'og chos 'byung gi nang du 'gro drug gi sems can rnams bsgom 'og rlung bskums nas/ 'dun pa rtse gcig tu btang bas de nyid kyis rmi lam lam rang zin/ sbyong spel 'phrul snang sgyu mar shar/ 'gro drug gi smin grol dang / yon tan drug 'char ro/ /gzhan yang drod skye ba dang thig le thub pa la sogs pa'i yon tan yang 'byung gsung ngo / /bzhi pa zhen med sgyu ma rang shar ni/ mnyam bzhag sngar bzhin byas la/ rjes spyod lam thams cad sgyu ma rmi lam du khyer bas/ cir snang thams cad bden med sgyu mar rang shar nas/ g.yas nas tsandan gyi dris mchod pa dang / g.yon nas mi gtsang bas 'thor ba dang / bstod pa dang smad pa la sogs pa thams cad la chags sdang dang dgag sgrub med par sgyu lus chags sdang rang grol du 'gyur ro/ /tshul 'di nyid sgyu lus dbang po rab 'bring gi skabs su'ang sbyar te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa rmi lam la chos drug las/ dang po rmi lam gzung ba la/ sngon 'gro gzhan sngar bzhin bsgoms la/ bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ rmi lam zin par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ 'di la gnyis las dang po rang zin ni/ thig le dbang bzhi'i gnad kyis gzung bar byas te/ rang gi spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gcig chad/ snying gar byung bas gti mug dag gsang gnas kyi hūm̐ las smad 'od zer dmar pos khengs thig le dmar po gcig chad/ stod 'od zer dkar pos khengs/ snying khar byung bas 'dod chags dag zhe sdang rang dag yin gsung ngo / /de nas thig le gnyis po snying khar chos 'khor du 'bros 'ded kyi tshul gyis sgo ro ro 'khor ba la rtse gcig tu dmigs la nga gnyid du song 'dug

'di ka rmi lam yin sgyu ma yin snyam du dran 'dun drag po bya/ thig le 'khor ba bum dbang / skabs su reg pa gsang dbang / reg pas bde ba skyes pa gsum pa/ gcig la gcig thim nas 'od du yal nas mi dmigs par song bar bsam pa bzhi pa'o/ /gnyid du 'gro khar thig le gcig la gcig thim nas mthar 'od du yal song ba'i mi rtog pa'i ngang la rmi lam gzung ngo / /des rmi lam rang zin 'byung gsung ngo / /zin pa'i tshul thog mar sad 'byam 'byung gnyid thum phras mang po 'byung / des rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes shing / de'ang 'jam zin dang rtsub zin gnyis gang rung 'byung gsung / bla ma rmog cog pa'i zhal nas/ phras sad dus su bsre ba gces/ /shar dang snang dang don byed dang / /shes nas grol bar khyad par med/ /ces gsungs pa ltar nyams su blang gsung ngo / /gnyis pa 'chug med ni/ sngar gyi des rang zin ma byung na/ dper na sems can gal 'geg la la 'dzin pa dang mtshungs/ 'chug pa med pa gal 'geg gi gnad rnam pa dgus gzung bar bya ste/ dus kyi gnad gsum ni/ rig pa gsal ba'i dus yin pas tho rangs nam langs nyi shar gyi rtse mo'o/ /lus kyi gnad gsum ni/ gnyid che chung gi rim pas/ dkyil krung / tsog pu/ seng ge'i nyal stabs so/ /dmigs pa'i gnad gsum las/ rtog med la 'dzin pa gnyis kyi dang po/ lha sku la bzung ba ni/ rang gi steng rlung thig le dkar ba dang 'grogs/ 'og rlung thig le dmar ba dang 'grogs/ lte bar 'khor ba la rmi lam sgyu ma'i dran 'dun rtse gcig tu byas la rlung gnyis kha sbyar ro/ /gnyid du 'gro khar thig le dkar ba sna bug g.yas nas thon/ dmar ba g.yon nas 'thon/ smin phrag du 'khor ba la dmigs la dran 'dun btang / de nas thig le dkar ba bde mchog dkar por gyur/ dmar ba yum du gyur pa mdun du dmigs la dran 'dun bya/ mthar yum yab la thim/ yab 'od du yal song ba'i mi rtog pa'i ngang la rmi lam gzung ngo /

/des kyang ma zin na/ gnyis pa bla ma la gzung ba ni/ rang bde mchog du bsgoms pa'i thugs khar bla ma de'i thugs khar hūm̐ dkar po gcig bsams nas/ hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bla ma gsal/ bla ma'i 'od kyis yi dam gsal ba la dran 'dun rtse gcig tu gtang ngo / /gnyid du 'gro khar yi dam bla ma la thim/ bla ma hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ 'od du yal song ba'i mi rtog pa'i ngang la rmi lam gzung ngo / /ye shes rgya mtsho las/ 'gro ba kun gyi mgrin par skye/ /yi ge oṃ bcas gnas pa nyid/ /ces so/ /gsum pa rtog bcas lam du 'khyer ba ni/ rmi lam zin par byed pa'i rgyu gnyid dang rmi lam bar gyi rtog ḍa ki nyer lnga'i lung par sleb pa dang 'dra gsung pa yin pas/ sngar gyi dmigs pa la sems gtad nas dran 'dun drag po btang ba'i mthar gnyid log pas/ gnyid du ma song ba'i snang ba 'gags/ gnyid dang rmi lam rags pa ma shar ba'i bar der/ mi'am phyugs la sogs pa'i rtog pa rab rib pa byung ba de/ 'di rmi lam du 'dug snyam du ngos zin par byas la/ mig mi 'byed par 'og rlung bskums pas/ des rmi lam mi zin mi srid gsung ngo / /gnyis pa sbyang ba la bzhi'i/ sngon 'gro gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'dir bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ sgyu lus rmi lam 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas nga gnyid du song 'dug lus 'di rmi lam gyi lus su 'dug snang ba 'di rmi lam gyi snang bar 'dug rmi lam gyi lus dang snang ba la ji ltar sbyang sbyang yin snyam du dran 'dun drag po btang nas/ dang po sems kyis lus sbyang ba ni/ 'og na mtsho'am g.yang sa chen po'i steng na rang lus 'dug pa'am 'dug par bsam pas 'jigs shing ya nga ba byung ba dang / rmi lam gyi g.yang la 'jigs shing ya nga rgyu ci yod snyam du bsams nas/ rang lus bde mchog du bsal ba de g.yang la phyad kyis bskur/ 'og tu slebs pa dang /

'od du yal song bar bsams la/ yang sngar bzhin yang yang du bsgom par bya'o/ /gnyis pa lus kyis sems sbyang ba ni/ rang gi lus kyi tshigs thams cad la hūm̐ sngon po re bsam/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas khog pa'i nang du song bas sdig sgrib nad gdon sha rus thams cad sbyangs nas/ rang lus 'od sngon por gyur/ de yi dam gyi lha snang la rang bzhin med par bsgoms/ 'di thams cad rang gi sems kyi rang snang yin/ sems gzung 'dzin bag chags kyi 'khrul snang sna tshogs su shar ba tsam yin gyi/ gshis la bden par grub pa gang yang med/ sems rig pa tsam po rang bzhin skye med/ mtshan nyid 'gag med/ 'di zung 'jug bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin yin snyam du thag bcad la/ lha sku phyag rgya chen po gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la bzhag go /gsum pa bdag med mas sbyang ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i nor bu la hūm̐ sngon po bsam/ mdun du bdag med ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa can gyi gsang gnas su/ oṃ a swā hā/ zhes pa sngon po bsams nas/ bzlas pa byas pas/ sngags las 'od zer sngon po byung nas nor bu'i hūm̐ la phog pas de'ang 'od du zhu ba 'dres nas gsang gnas na yar song bas/ lus bde khril byung nas/ sdig sgrib la sogs pa sngar ltar sbyangs par bsams la dran 'dun btang / yang sngags bzlas pas 'od byung nas bdag med ma la phog pas 'od du zhu nas gsang gnas na yar song bas/ sngar ltar sbyangs par bsam zhing / mthar rang lus 'od sngon po de yang / sngo yal gyi stong sangs kyis song nas/ phyag rgya chen po gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang la bzhag par bya'o/ /bdag med mas sbyang ba ltar yi dam gyi lha gzhan la yang sbyang bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa 'dun pas sbyang ba ni/ 'byung bzhi dang sems can mig gis mthong tsam nas/ ri dang rta glang la sogs pa phra rags thams cad la rang lus phar thal tshur thal la sogs par sbyang ngo / /gsum pa spel ba la gnyis kyi sngon 'gro gzhan sngar ltar byas la/

nga gnyid du song 'dug 'di rmi lam du 'dug rmi lam gyi lus dang snang ba la ji ltar spel spel yin snyam du dran 'dun btang nas/ dang po thug phrad du spel ba'i bzhi ni/ 'byung bzhi phra ba dang rags pa dang / sems can phra ba dang rags pa/ gang snang thams cad gcig las bcu bcu las brgya stong khri 'bum la sogs pa bar snang sa gzhi khengs par spel lo/ /gnyis pa gang 'dul du spel ba la gnyis las/ dang po 'jig rten pa'i gang 'dul du spel ba ni/ pha rol byi ba lta bu la byi la/ bye'u la khra/ khyi la spyang khyi/ spyang khyi la stag stag la seng ge mi la srin po la sogs pa gang 'dul du sprul zhing / sngar ltar spel nas za ba dang / mid pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas gdul bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa 'das pa'i gang 'dul du spel ba ni/ klu 'dul ba la khyung / rgyal po 'dul ba la rta mgrin/ klu bdud 'dul pa la 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'/ klu srin dang gnod sbyin la phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa gang 'dul kyi khro bor sprul zhing / gong ltar spel nas za zhing mid pa dang / phyag mtshan gyis gtub pa dang / me dpung gis bsregs pa la sogs pas btul na/ srog sngags 'bul zhing bka' 'bangs byed pa la sogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa sprul ba'ang tshul de nyid kyis shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa bsgyur ba la bzhi yi/ sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra ba las/ nga gnyid du song 'dug 'di rmi lam du 'dug rmi lam gyi lus dang snang ba la ji ltar bsgyur bsgyur yin snyam du bsams nas/ dang po 'byung bzhi phra rags su bsgyur ba ni/ sa las chu/ chu las me/ me las rlung la sogs par bsgyur zhing / de rnams kyang phra ba las rags pa dang / rags pa las phra ba/ gcig las bcu la sogs pa mang por bsgyur ro/ /gnyis pa sems can phra rags la yang de bzhin no/ /gsum pa lha sku sna tshogs su bsgyur ba ni/ lha sku dkar ba las dmar ba la sogs pa sku mdog dang / zhal phyag mang nyung sna tshogs gcig las bcu la sogs pa mang por bsgyur bar bya'o/

/bzhi pa snang stong zhen bral du bsgyur ba ni/ lha sku la sogs pa de rnams thams cad kyang gcig gis gcig la ma bsgribs pa snang la rang bzhin med pa/ blo bral gsal stong rjen pa zhen med sgyu ma rang shar du bsgyur cing rtogs par bya'o/ /drug pa yul snang la bzhi las/ dang po rab dmigs med gsal mkhyen ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags dang bral bas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i ngang nas nyin mtshan med par sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dang / rigs drug gi gnas la sogs pa/ dag pa'i sa gsum la gnas pa ltar mkhyen no/ /gnyis pa 'bring gang bsam gsal mthong ni/ rmi lam zin nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la sogs gang lta bar 'dod pa de bsam pa dang mthong ba dus mnyam du 'byung ngo / /gsum pa tha ma yid lus mkha' lding ni/ rmi lam zin nas rang bya rgod la sogs par sprul nas 'phur nas phyin pas/ gang lta bar 'dod pa de nyid du sleb nas mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa dman pa dmigs pa yul snang la gsum gyi/ sngon 'gro gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ 'dir bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ yul snang gtan la phebs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ dang po bdag med ma yul snang 'char byed ni/ rang lus yi dam du bskyed pa'i lte bar/ thod pa chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba'i nang du/ oṃ a swāhā/ zhes pa 'od kyi rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs su bsam la bzlas pa byas pas/ de las 'od kha dog lnga ldan byung nas sna bug g.yon nas phar 'phros pas 'od zer gyi sna la bdag med ma la sogs pa yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pa rang rang gi sngags di ri ri sgrogs pa byung nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang bas/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar byas/ yang bzlas pa byas pas sngags las 'od zer sna bug g.yas nas phar 'phros pas/ phyi snod 'od kyi gzhal yas khang du gyur/

'od zer gyi sna la phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pa thogs pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa byung nas/ yi dam de rnams la mchod par bsam zhing / yi dam gyi lha khyed kyi do nub kyi skabs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams la sogs pa gang lta bar 'dod pa de mthong ba dang / mchod pa rgya chen po grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab cing nyin mtshan gnyis ka de ltar bsgom/ mthar gnyid du 'gro khar rang nyid kyi lte ba'i thod pa'i nang gi sngags de bdag med mar gyur/ de la sngar bzhin gsol ba btab nas de'i thugs khar gang lta bar 'dod pa'i zhing khams la sogs pa'i yul snang de me long gzugs brnyan ltar bkra lam me gsal btab la gnyid log par bya'o/ /gnyis pa a thog mar dbu mthong de nas rgya chen mthong yul snang rang gsal ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i rtsa dbu ma/ yar rtse tshangs bug la slebs pa mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i nang / lte bar a skye ba med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin dkar la 'tsher ba gsal la dwang ba'i 'od kyis dbu ma dkar lam me khengs pa la nyin mtshan med par rtse gcig tu bsgom par bya'o/ /gsum pa thig le yul snang gsal byed ni/ rang gi spyi bo'i haṃ las thig le dkar po/ gsang gnas kyi hūm̐ las dmar po dang / lte ba'i a las thig le dmar skya byung nas/ de rnams snying khar 'dres cing gcig tu gyur pa'i 'od zer ba thag lta bu gang lta bar 'dod pa'i yul snang der bcug la/ de la sems rtse gcig tu gtad nas gnyid log par bya'o/ /de rnams kyis yul snang ji lta ba bzhin gtan la mi phebs mi srid do/ /de yang dang por rmi lam legs par zin nas brtan pa thob pa dang / de nas rim gyis sbyong spel la sogs bya gsung ngo / ༈ /bzhi pa 'od gsal la gsum gyi/ dang po sngon 'gro la bzhi las/ rtsa ba mi rtag skyo shas ni/ sngar sgyu lus su bshad pa ltar/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang /

'khor ba'i nyes dmig bsam la skyo shas drag po bskyed pa ni rtsa ba'o/ /gnyis pa yal ga spyod lam rdzas ni/ kha zas 'jam la snum pa bza' zhing / tshod zin par bya/ spyod lam shin tu dal ba bsten/ rngul thon pa'i las rnams spang ngo / gu gul tshil chen dud pa btang / dam rdzas ni/ tshogs dang gtor ma bzang du bshams la bla ma/ yi dam/ chos skyong / gzhi bdag gnod byed rnams la gtor ma lnga rim pa bzhin phul la/ 'od gsal 'char bar gsol ba gdab cing bar chad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las gzhol/ thod pa mtshan ldan gyi nang du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'am de'i gtor ma bcug la/ dar gyi gril te sngas 'og du bcug pas mkha' 'gro 'du zhing bar chad bsrung ba'i rten 'brel du 'gyur gsung ngo / /gsum pa lo 'dab thabs lam rang dwang ni/ zas skom bcud can bsten/ gtum mo la sogs pa thabs lam bsgoms pas thig le rgyas shing / rlung sems dwangs nas 'od gsal myur du 'char ro/ /bzhi pa me tog gsol 'debs 'char byed ni/ 'od gsal byin rlabs kyi gnad/ byin rlabs mos gus kyi gnad yin pas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gong bzhin bsgoms la/ bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ 'od gsal 'byongs par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ mos gus rab 'bring dang sbyar nas 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa 'char la rtog pa med par dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gtad pas 'od gsal mi zin mi srid do/ /gnyis pa lam khyer la gnyis las/ nyin par sku gsum lam khyer ni/ a la sogs pa la sems gtod pa bzhin du/ nyin par cir snang thams cad la sgrim lhod ran par sems gtad nas bzo med du bzhag pas gsal cha ma 'gag la 'dzin cha ma zhugs pa'i gsal stong 'dzin med du 'char la/ de'i gsal ba'i cha sprul sku/ 'dzin med stong pa chos sku/ de nyams su myong bas bde bar shar ba longs sku yin pas/ de ltar lam du dgyer ro/

/gnyis pa mtshan mo sku gsum rang shar ni/ nyin par de ltar 'bad nas bsgoms pa dang / khyad par gnyid du 'gro khar 'od gsal bzung ba'i skabs ltar bsgoms pas/ gnyid du 'gro ba'i nag thibs pa de/ nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur nas gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa sku gsum rang shar du 'byung ngo / /de byung na 'od gsal zin pa yin no/ /gsum pa bsre ba la bzhi las/ dang po gsal stong bde chen du bsre ba ni/ gzugs sdug mi sdug la sogs pa cir snang thams cad 'od gsal du khyer bas sems nyid sna tshogs su ma 'gags par snang ba gsal ba/ 'dzin cha dag nas ngo bo ngos gzung ci yang mi 'dug pas stong pa de'i nyams myong zhen pa'i dri ma dang bral bas bde chen du shar ba ste/ de rnams dbyer med du nyams su len pa la bsre ba zhes bya'o/ /gnyis pa nyin mtshan dbyer med du bsre ba ni/ nyin mo'i 'od gsal gyis mtshan mo'i stobs bskyed/ mtshan mo'i 'od gsal gyis nyin mo'i stobs bskyed pas dbyer med du 'gyur la/ khyad par du gnyid du ma song ba'i snang ba 'gags/ gnyid dang rmi lam ma shar ba'i bar der rtog pa ma zhugs par sems rtse gcig tu gtad pas nges par 'dre'o/ /gsum pa lta stangs kyi mnyam rjes su bsre ba ni/ mnyam bzhag bar 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bzhi'i/ dang po 'od gsal bzung ba la dgu las/ dus kyi gnad gsum dang / lus kyi gnad gsum ni rmi lam gzung ba'i skabs su bshad pa ltar ro/ /dmigs pa'i gnad gsum gyi sngon 'gro sngar ltar byas la/ dang po a la gzung ba ni/ rtsa thams cad dbu mar bsgom rang yi dam du gsal ba'i rtsa dbu ma/ yar rtse tshangs bug dang mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa/ phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i nang / lte 'og sor bzhir rang gi sems nyid a dkar la 'tsher ba/ gsal la dwangs pa'i 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsams la/ a'i rang bzhin skye med du shes par byas la/

yid gsal la rtog pa med pa'i ngang la bzhag go /gnyis pa bdag med ma la gzung ba ni/ rang gi klad pa'i steng / thod pa'i 'og tu bdag med ma dkar mo sku chung la yan lag gri thod thogs pa dod pa gcig bsam/ de'i thugs khar a dkar po gcig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas klad pa gti mug gi gnas yin pas rang bzhin med par sbyangs nas thod pa dung khang gi gzhal yas khang / 'od kyi rang bzhin dkar lam me ba la sems rtse gcig tu gtad par bya'o/ /gsum pa bla ma la gzung ba ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs khar/ bla ma thig le'i ngo bo'i/ bde ba'i rang bzhin dngul chu'i mdog can gcig bsam/ de'i thugs khar hūm̐ dkar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig bsam la/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros bla ma gsal/ bla ma las 'od 'phros yi dam gsal bar bsam la/ rtse gcig tu gtad la bsgom/ 'od gsal gzung ba'i dmigs pa 'di rnams la ma yengs pa'i ngang nas sgrim lhod ran par byas la nyin mtshan gnyis kar rtse gcig tu 'bad la bsgom/ khyad par du gnyid du 'gro khar gnyid du ma song ba'i snang ba 'gags/ gnyid dang rmi lam rags pa ma shar ba'i bar der/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis ma g.yengs par gsal la 'od gsal 'char yang / rjes la lus ngag gi bya bas g.yo bar 'gyur na/ spyod lam thams cad du dran pas bzung nas/ cir snang thams cad la glang po che'i lta stangs kyis mig 'bru tshugs su bltas nas/ sems 'dzin med du bzhag pas/ mnyam rjes med par 'od gsal 'char ro/ /bzhi pa shes rab bde stong du bsre ba ni/ rang lus thabs ldan dang / gzhan lus shes rab ma la brten pa'i bde ba gang yin yang / bde ba de nyid kyi ngo bo la yid ma g.yengs par gtad nas/ sems ma bcos par bzhag pas/ bde bar snang ba ma 'gag la zhen pa'i dri ma dag nas bde stong dbyer med du 'char ro/ /bzhi pa mthar thug gi 'od gsal la lnga las/ dang po gsal stong rang shar gyi 'od gsal ni/ de ltar nyams su blangs pas mngon du gyur pa na/

gzugs snang stong sgra grag stong la sogs par 'char zhing / dran rtog thams cad rang shar rang grol du 'gyur la/ des gsal bar snang ba nyid stong par 'char la/ stong pa nyid gsal bar 'char bas/ gsal stong rang shar zung 'jug 'ba' zhig du 'char ro/ /gnyis pa bde stong rang shar yang tshul de nyid kyis shes te/ gsal stong nyams su myong ba nyid bde bar 'char la/ de la zhen pa'i dri ma dag pas de nyid bde stong du rang shar ba yin no/ /gsum pa zab zhi spros bral ni/ mthar thug gi 'od gsal de nyid rtogs shing nyams su myong ba/ de'i rang bzhin blo'i yul las 'das pas zab pa/ gzung 'dzin gyi dri ma dag pas zhi ba/ yod med la sogs pa'i mthar 'dzin las grol bas spros bral/ rgyu rkyen gyi 'dus ma byas shing 'bad rtsol la mi ltos pas lhun gyis grub pa'o/ /bzhi pa dbyer med mthar thug ni/ bde gsal las gud na stong pa med/ stong pa las gud na bde gsal med/ stong pa nyid bde gsal/ bde gsal nyid stong pa ste/ de rnams gang du'ang dbyer mi phyed pa'i 'od gsal gyi rtogs par 'khor 'das kyi chos du ma ro gcig du gyur pa'o/ /lnga pa dag pa gnyis ldan gyi 'od gsal ni/ sems nyid rang bzhin gyis dag cing 'od gsal ba la/ gzung 'dzin glo bur gyi dri mas dag pa'am/ chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar rtogs pas nyon mongs pa'i dri ma dag sgyu 'dzin tsam shes bya'i sgrib pa de yang / 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs pas dag par 'gyur ba'o/ /'od gsal zhes pa'ang ngo bo cir yang ma grub pa'i sems skye med rig stong / kho rang gi rang 'od rtsal 'gag med/ snang ba sna tshogs su gsal bar shar ba'o/ /gsum pa rjes la lnga las/ dang po dam tshig spyi dang bye brag ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung bas ma gos par byed pa spyi yin la 'od gsal thig le'i mdangs yin pas/ byang sems mi nyams par bsrung ba ni bye brag ste/

tshul de las mi 'da' ba'i don gyis na dam tshig go /gnyis pa gags sel nyes skyon rang grol ni/ 'od gsal 'char ba'i gegs 'khrul pa'i dran rtog yin la/ dran rtog sems yin/ sems gsal stong bde chen du shar ba'i 'od gsal de nyid lam du khyer bas skyon rang grol du 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa bogs 'don the tshom gcod byed ni/ bla ma'i mos gus rtse gcig tu bya zhing gsol ba drag po gdab pa dang / sems can gyi sdug bsngal bsam la snying rje chen po bskyed par bya zhing / gsal stong 'dzin med kyi 'od gsal de nyid kyi steng du/ so sor rtog pa'i shes rab kyis yang yang gzhig cing thag bcad pas/ sangs rgyas byon yang dri rgyu med snyam pa'i thag chod kyi nges shes brtan po skyes pas/ bogs thon nas the tshom ma lus pa chod par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa khyad 'phags 'char sgo ngos 'dzin la bzhi/ bde gsal mi rtog pa zung du chud pa'i 'char sgo sna tshogs ni bla ma'i gsung bzhin gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /lnga pa nyams rtogs nyin mtshan khyad par ni/ myong ba tsam du mtshungs kyang thag chod kyi nges shes brtan po ma skyes pas/ zhig cing yal nas 'gro ba ni nyams kyi yin la/ nang du rtsa mdud gcig grol bas gsal stong gnyis med du rtogs nas/ mi 'gyur ba'i thag chod kyi nges shes khyad par can skyes pas/ yin min gyi sgro 'dogs the tshom med las grol ba ni rtogs pa'i 'od gsal yin no/ /nyin mtshan gyi khyad par ni/ gsal stong 'dzin med rang shar du 'byung bar mtshungs kyang / mtshan mo'i 'od gsal stobs che bas/ bzang zhing 'char yang dkar la/ nyin mo'i de ltar ma yin pa dang / gnyid sad rgyu yod med tsam gyis bzhag gsung ngo / 'di yan ldan bzhugs yod do/ ༈ /lnga pa 'pho ba la bzhi/ chos sku de bzhin nyid kyi 'pho ba/ zung 'jug yi dam gyi 'pho ba/ byin rlabs bla ma'i 'pho ba/ 'chug med mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba zhes gsungs kyang /

phyag len la bla ma ra hū la'i gdams pa sdig po che btsan thabs su tshangs rgya bar byed pa 'pho ba ye shes skar khung ma zhes bya ba 'di la mdzad de/ 'di nyams su len par 'dod pas/ thog mar sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang skad gcig gis yi dam lhar bskyed pa'i spyi bor/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor sngar bzhin bsgoms la/ bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ bar dor tshangs rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab/ bzlas pa ci rigs pa gcig bya/ de nas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i rtsa dbu ma phyi dkar la nang dmar ba 'od kyi rang bzhin/ yar rtse tshangs bug du slebs pa/ mar sna gsang gnas su zug pa stong sang nge yod pa'i nang / lte ba'i thad dkar chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba 'od kyi rang bzhin/ zur mdun du bstan pa/ logs sgal pa la gtad pa gcig bsgom/ de'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo a dkar po 'od 'phro ba dang bcas pa 'phur la khad pa yed yed yod pa gcig bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas rlung ro lan gsum phyir bsal la sked pa nyeg nyeg pa lan gsum byas nas steng 'og gi rlung nar gyis drangs la drag tu gzung / khyad par du 'og rlung drag po drangs te/ lte ba sgal pa la char gyis sbyar bas lte ba'i chos 'byung kha nang du char gyis song ba dang / lte ba'i nang gi a de rang dbang med par a ba dhu ti'i nang na yar rgyangs kyi thon nas spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar rgyangs kyis song ba dang a 'od du yal gyis song ste de'i ngang la phyag rgya chen por lhan gyis bzhag de 'dra ba thengs bdun bya/ de'i rjes la spyi bor a gcig lam gyis byung bar bsam la/ de tshangs pa'i bu ga na mar song nas/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mar bde khril li li song bas chos 'byung gi nang du dkar yer gyis byung ba dang / de la sems gtad la bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngang la sings kyis bzhag

de lta bu'i sbyor bas nus tshad du bsgoms par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pas rtags rab 'bring gsum du 'byung ste/ rab la spyi bo brdol nas khrag dang chu ser 'ong / 'bring gis spyi bor skrangs nas 'ong / tha ma'i spyi bor za ba dang 'gul ba dang 'phrig pa 'ong / de ltar byung tsam na 'byongs pa'i rtags yin no/ /bsgom pa'i dus su thal gyis dogs na/ rin po che'i snod kyis mgo nas mnan/ des thub la/ gzhan gyis mi thub bo gsung ngo / /de ltar bsgoms pa'i rten gyi gang zag de la/ nam zhig 'chi rtags tshang zhing nges par 'chi bar yid ches pa'am/ yang na khyad par gyi 'chi rtags ni/ bla ma ra hū la'i bzhed pas/ rlung gnyis mnyam du rgyu na rnal 'byor myur du 'chi/ /zhes bshad pas/ srog rlung dbu mar 'dus pa'i rtags kha sna gnyis nas rlung dus gcig la mnyam shwa shwa byung ba'i rtags de byung na 'chi nges pa yin pas rang gi lus dang longs spyod nye du 'brel ba gang la yang chags par mi bya/ snang srid 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu mar shes par byas la/ gang la'ang chags par mi bya/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed bya/ rang lha skur dran par byas la/ spyi bor bla ma bsgoms la gsol ba gdab/ gzhan don gyi smon lam rnam par dag pa rgya chen po gdab cing / 'du 'dzi dang g.yeng ba phyir kyed nas/ rang gcig pur bsdad la 'pho bar bya ste/ de yang sngon du rtsa kha 'byed pa'i gdams ngag ni/ rang dang bud med thig le yis/ /rlung sems gnyis po yar la 'dren/ /tsha las rtsa kha 'byed par byed/ /mi yi klad pas bar chad bsrung / /zhes bshad do/ /de ltar rdzas sna bzhi po de lag mthil du srin lag g.yon pas mnyes la/ yi dam lha'i sngags btab ste/ spyi bor blugs la rlung mi bzung bar rang sor bzhag go /dmigs pa ni/ chos 'byung gi a yar la rgyangs rgyangs btang nas skye med kyi ngang la bzhag la/

de'i ngang du 'pho bar bya'o/ /de nyid bsdus te bsgom par 'dod pas/ byang chub kyi sems sngon du song bas rang yi dam du bskyed pa'i lte bar chos 'byung gi nang du yig ge a dkar po gcig bsgom/ de nas 'og rlung 'then te steng rlung mnan pas/ a de a ba dhu ti'i nang na yar song bas/ spyi bo na yar dkar rgyangs rgyangs song ba dang / stong pa nyid kyi ngang du song bar bsam mo/ /de ltar byas pas bar dor 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po rtogs te mngon par rdzogs par tshangs rgya'o/ ༈ /drug pa bar do la bzhi yi/ dang po rab bar do dang po'i 'od gsal rang shar du sangs rgyas pa ni/ sngar rnam smin dang bag chags kyi lus la nyin mtshan du bsgoms pa'i bu'i 'od gsal dang / 'chi ba'i tshe yul yul can thim pa'i rim pa la mkhas pas rlung sems thams cad a ba dhu tir tshogs ba'i rten 'brel las/ rang bzhin brgyad cus bsdus pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa phra rags thams cad 'gags te/ sems nyid gsal stong mtha' dbus thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' dwangs pa lta bu/ lus can 'chi ba thams cad la rang shar du byung ba de ni rang bzhin ma'i 'od gsal zhes bya ste/ dus der 'od gsal ma bu gnyis phrad pas chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med gcig tu 'dres/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad pa bzhin rang ngo shes te/ sngar gyi 'dun pa'i dbang gis dbyer med mngon gyur gyi 'od gsal gyi rtogs pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar gnas par gyur bas/ bar dor rigs drug gi lha grong khyer mi mthong bar/ 'od gsal skye med chos sku la brtan pa thob cing / skye med kyi ngang las dag pa'i sgyu lus su langs te/ gzugs sku gnyis 'gag med rang shar lhun grub tu byung nas/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can rnams smin cing grol bar byed do/ /'di nyams su len tshul ni/ 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa nyid yin pas 'dir ma spros so/

/gnyis pa 'bring rgyal ba longs sku rang shar ni/ sngar 'od gsal la goms pa chung bas/ bar do dang po'i 'od gsal la gnas par ma nus na/ bdun phrag dang po'i bar dor rgyal ba longs skur sangs rgyas par bya ste/ 'di nyams su len tshul ni/ sngon 'gro gzhan sngar bzhin byas la/ bdag 'dzin blos thongs par/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar/ bar dor rgyal ba longs skur tshangs rgya bar mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas rang shi nas bar do na gnas par bsgom par bya ste/ a nga shi 'dug nga'i lus 'di bar do yid kyi lus su 'dug zas 'di bar do'i zas/ gos bar do'i gos/ grogs thams cad bar do'i grogs/ snod bcud kyi snang ba 'di thams cad bar do'i snang bar 'dug snyam du cir snang thams cad la ma g.yengs par dran 'dun btang la skyo shas drag po bskyed/ sngar bla ma'i zhal nas bar do la bar dor ngo shes par gyis la rgyal ba longs sku ru nyams su longs shig gsung ba'i dus der slebs nas 'dug pas da bar do la skrag par mi bya ste/ dus 'dir tshangs rgya ba'i phyir ro snyam du bsam nas/ sngar bzhin bla ma la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ bar do'i snang ba 'di thams cad rang gi sems kyi rang snang yin gyis phyi rol na grub pa yang med/ rang snang thams cad bden med sgyu ma rmi lam yin snyam du bsgom/ khyad par du yi dam gyi sprul bsgyur la 'dun pa btang / phyi snod gzhal yas khang nang bcud lha dang lha mo/ rang nyid rgyal ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa/ snang la rang bzhin med pa gsal la rtog pa med pa/ bde la zhen pa med pa'i lha sku phyag rgya chen po chos kyi sku'i ngo bo/ longs sku'i rnam pa sprul sku'i 'phrin las dbyer med bde ba chen po'i skur gsal btab la dran 'dun drag pos nyams su blangs pas/ bar dor sngar gyi 'dun pa'i dbang gis/ rgyal ba longs sku rang shar du snang nas/

'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa tha ma sprul sku 'gag med rang shar ni/ sngar 'od gsal dang lha sku la goms pa chung bas bar do dang por 'od gsal dang bdun phrag dang por longs skur gnas ma nus na mngal sgo sbyangs nas sprul skur tshangs rgya bar bya ste/ 'di'i nyams su len tshul ni/ sngon 'gro dang / skyo shas sngar ltar byas la sngar bla ma'i zhal nas bar do la bar dor ngo shes par gyis la mngal sgo sbyangs te/ rgyal ba sprul sku nyams su longs shig gsungs pa'i dus der slebs 'dug pas/ da ni bar do la skrag par mi bya ste/ dus 'di nyid du tshangs rgya ba'i phyir ro snyam du bsam/ pha ma la sogs pa pho mo la brten pa'i chags sdang dang / phrag dog mig ser skyes pa'i tshe/ kye ma chags sdang gis skye ba len pa 'di ni shin tu sdug bsngal ba ste/ da ni dag pa bde chen gyi zhing du 'gro'o snyam du bsam la/ chags sdang sbyangs/ bar do'i snang ba 'di thams cad rang snang / rang snang thams cad bden med sgyu ma yin rmi lam yin snyam pa dang / bla ma'i mos gus dang gsum la 'dun pa btang ngo / /de'i rjes la rang gi mdun du chos 'byung gru gsum mthing kha rkyang pa'am nyis brtsegs gcig bsam la/ 'di ma rtogs pa rnams la ma'i mngal/ rtogs pa rnams la 'og min chos kyi pho brang yin snyam du sgom/ de'i dbus su rang sems hūm̐ ngam thig le sngon po gcig du bsam/ de las 'od kha dog lnga 'phros pas/ 'das pa'i skye gnas lnga'i lan chags dang dri ma dag da ltar gyi mngal gyi lan chags dang dri ma sbyangs/ ma 'ongs pa'i mngal sgo bkag par bsgom mo/ /de nas hūm̐ de gyur pa las/ rang yi dam yab yum du bsam/ chags sdang gi yul pho mor snang ba thams cad yab yum gyi sa bon las chos 'byung gi nang gi g.yas zur du pho thams cad yi dam yab du bsam/

g.yon zur du mo thams cad yum du bsgoms la/ mchod pa dbul zhing gsol ba gdab/ sgra grags tshad thams cad sngags su blta/ dran rtog thams cad la glang po che'i lta stangs kyis lha sku phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de ltar dran 'dun drag pos nyams su blangs pas/ bar dor sngar gyi 'dun pa'i dbang gis rang gzhan snod bcud thams cad snang stong zhen bral gyi yi dam sprul sku'i snang ba 'ba' zhig rang shar du 'byung la/ sgra grags pa thams cad sngags su 'char zhing / dran rtog thams cad gnyis med phyag rgya chen po'i rtogs par shar nas/ chags sdang mig ser thams cad dag pas mngal sgo khegs te skye ba mi len par dus de nyid du sprul skur sangs rgyas te/ 'khor ba ma stongs kyi bar du gang la gang 'dul gyis sems can thams cad smin cing grol bar byed par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa spyi gnad 'chug med lam khyer ni/ dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i gsum ka'i nyams len gyi skabs su/ bar do skyo shas kyi gnad ces pas/ bar do'i skyo shas dran 'dun gyi skyo shas drag po dang ma bral bas/ pho mo la sogs pa chags sdang gi yul thams cad rang snang bden med sgyu ma rmi lam du thag bcad la sbyang / bdag gzhan snod bcud thams cad yi dam yab yum du bsgoms la/ sprul bsgyur la 'dun pa btang / bla ma'i snang ba dang mi 'bral bar/ mos gus rtse gcig tu bya zhing gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ sngar bstan pas grub pa nyid do/ /'dir skabs su nye bar bab pa nyams len gyi dmigs pa rnams dngos su bstan pa yin la/ rgyas par bla ma khyung po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i 'chug med bar do gsum gyi gdams pa ji lta ba bzhin gsung bas der shes par bya'o/ /tshul 'di gang gi drin gyis rtogs gyur pa/ /srid gsum bla ma yon tan rin chen gter/ /'gro mgon chos rje shangs ston rin po che'i/ /zhabs pad dri ma med la phyag 'tshal lo/
